### Account switch can show stale Perps data **High Severity** `initForAddress` now nulls `initializedAddress` before `init()`, so the address-change path that used to `reset()` channels never runs. In-flight REST fallbacks are not cancelled and can push the previous account's positions, orders, or account state after the switch. At the same time, `handleBackgroundUpdate` drops every stream payload while `pendingInit` is set, including the new session's first WebSocket snapshots, so the cache stays empty and that stale REST write can win.

### Timeout leaves streams muted or torn down **High Severity** A 30s connection timeout that fires before `perpsStartPreload` leaves the bridge activated with no `preloadId`, so `canEmit` stays false and Home/Discover get no updates while subscriptions leak. If timeout or `perpsStopPreload` runs after preload started and no Perps view is open, `destroy()` drops every stream; `PerpsStreamManager` still reports the address as initialized, so already-mounted hooks never re-run `perpsInit` or `perpsActivatePriceStream`.

### Stream remount still loses subscriptions **Medium Severity** `#initAndActivate` now holds the shared account queue only until `#perpsInit` settles, then releases it before callers subscribe. A queued `#initForAccount` can `#detachForAccountSwitch` in the same turn, so `#activateDynamicWhenReady` and candle activation see a generation mismatch and skip the subscribe. The activation still resolves, and `usePerpsLivePrices` will not retry on the same symbols, so live prices can stay missing after an account switch during connect.

### EVM init rejected on non-EVM selection **High Severity** `usePerpsStreamManager` and `usePerpsPreload` now send `getSelectedEvmInternalAccount` to `perpsInitForAccount`, but the bridge still treats `accountsController.getSelectedAccount()` as current. body:
Timeout / cleanup call `perpsStopPreload(id)` before this UI ever assigns that id on the bridge.

`initForAddress` runs first and can finish `perpsInit` (`#walletInitialized = true`, `#activate()`, static WS up). Only then does `perpsStartPreload(id)` set `#preloadId`. If the 30s timer (or unmount) fires in that window:

1. `cancelled` skips `perpsStartPreload`, so `#preloadId` stays `null`
2. `release()` is a no-op on the bridge (`#preloadId === id` is false)
3. Home keeps a live Perps socket with no matching stop id until lock / last-UI grace

Assign the owner id **before** `perpsInit` (or pass `id` into `initForAccount`), and make timeout/`cancelled` bump `#destroyGeneration` / `destroy()` even when `#preloadId` was never set. Right now this timer is a trace deadline, not a connection abort.
action: Addressed and replied to in an earlier round of this PR; thread already resolved.

body:
This only tears down when `#preloadId === id`. `#preloadId` is assigned in `#startPreload`, which runs **after** `initForAddress` on the UI path.

`usePerpsPreload` always `release()`s the same UUID on timeout and unmount. If init is still in flight (or completed after `cancelled`), this branch never runs, so `destroy()` never runs either — even with `#walletInitialized` already true.

Stop should abort in-flight init for this UI even when `#preloadId` is still null (generation bump / destroy), not wait for a later `perpsStartPreload` that may never come.

body:
`destroy()` drops unsubs and clears `#walletInitialized`, but it does not call `#perpsDisconnect()`.

`isPreloadAllowed` is only polled on API calls. When the remote Perps flag flips off, UI `enabled` goes false and `perpsStopPreload` can hit this `destroy()` (`!isPreloadAllowed()`). Subscriptions stop; the Hyperliquid provider session can stay connected.

If remote disable is an ops lever, pair this with `perpsDisconnect` / `#disconnectPerpsIfActive()` whenever eligibility is false for every UI — not only `stopMarketDataPreload` in `#releasePreload`.

Unlock preload activates this fills subscription, but `canEmit` never includes `'fills'` (only positions / orders / account / markets / prices / connectionState).

Either add `'fills'` to the wallet-level allowlist if Home/Discover should see them, or subscribe to order fills only once a Perps view is active so preload does not pay for a stream the UI discards.

### Dispose skips reconnect grace period **High Severity** `dispose()` treats any session that registered a preload as abandoned because `perpsInit` never sets `#walletInitialized` while `#preloadId` is present. Closing the last UI therefore calls `#disconnectIfUnowned` immediately, which invalidates fills and disconnects the provider instead of leaving teardown to the existing last-UI grace window. Brief close/reopen loses the warm session and cached fills.
Additional Locations (2) - [`app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L350-L352`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/cf5296878f33675d71f2b6a5507e47c387ff29f0/app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L350-L352) - [`app/scripts/metamask-controller.js#L4961-L4978`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/cf5296878f33675d71f2b6a5507e47c387ff29f0/app/scripts/metamask-controller.js#L4961-L4978)
